changeReasons.reason: Only the Alaska TF-810 sales policy changed: new import of akCourtviewSalesPolicy from src/lib/expungement-ai/ak-courtview-contact.ts, which returns null unless state is AK on the AK CourtView pathway; placeholder enabled only when the policy is not allowed:false; policy refusal as the last gate of requireConsumerPacketPurchaseReadiness; optional ConsumerCheckoutNotAllowedError participantMessage defaulting to the prior message. For SC the policy is null, so placeholder, checkout, delivery, credit and commercial-admission denials are unchanged. ak-courtview-contact.ts newly pinned as replayed module graph dependency; all other 15 previously reviewed dependencies unchanged. ak-courtview-contact.ts re-pinned after 3b1e33b32 (AK-only conflict-guidance support sentence and {value}-wrapper clarification check, both behind the non-AK null/empty returns); reviewer rerun at 3b1e33b32 byte-identical, replay unchanged. Re-pinned 2026-10-18 at 086a6e363: lead commit 2499d09fe changed only two Spanish display strings (AK email prompt and helper) in ak-courtview-contact.ts; independent SC replay at 086a6e363 byte-identical in both modes and unreachable from SC (scratchpad/independent-review-sc-086a6e363/REVIEW.json).
